summary: Master financial modeling for oil and gas projects with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential skills for effective project analysis.
lede: Oil and gas financial modeling connects production forecasts, project costs, fiscal terms, and financing to assess project economics. For petroleum economists, project finance analysts, reservoir engineers, and commercial managers, it supports building integrated Excel models to evaluate investment cases. Learners practise translating production into cash flow, valuing projects with DCF metrics, and testing scenarios while documenting assumptions and model controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with project economics, financial analysis, technical forecasts, or commercial decisions in the oil and gas value chain. It suits intermediate to advanced learners who need stronger model integration rather than introductory spreadsheet instruction.
modules: Oil and Gas Project Economics Foundations
Integrated Project Case and Model Audit
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of oil and gas project economics, financial statements, discounted cash flow concepts, and Microsoft Excel formulas. Experience with production forecasts, capital expenditure estimates, operating costs, or project finance will help. No programming is required. Power Query, Power Pivot, and Monte Carlo exercises use prepared datasets and templates, so you do not need prior coding experience. Advanced probabilistic analysis receives operational application rather than technical engineering depth.
